name: cross-platform-v1
invalidation_rules: source revision or tree cannot be resolved
profile, workload, or runner root mismatch
unsupported CPython, operating system, or architecture
Core build or correctness gate failure
silent task, future, cancellation, timeout, error, relay, or shutdown failure
deleted or selectively excluded scored observation

evidence_policy.raw_observations: retain every scored observation in emission order
evidence_policy.outliers: never delete or selectively exclude scored observations
evidence_policy.thresholds: report-only; no universal latency or throughput SLO
evidence_policy.overlap_authority: Single-Host Qualification owns release evidence; this profile is an exact-revision service-plane facet consumed as Gate Measurement evidence

claim_boundary.qualified: the observed CPython 3.13 service-plane envelope on the exact measured platform and revision
claim_boundary.advisory: comparisons across machines, revisions, or profiles and all reported latency, throughput, CPU, RSS, and soak values
claim_boundary.unqualified: journal and data-plane hot paths, Core ordering semantics, production capacity, hard real-time behavior, and any platform without retained exact-revision evidence
